description: Unit test class for EmployeeLanguageDao, testing CRUD operations, search filters, and allowed languages within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of EmployeeLanguageDao methods, including save, retrieve, search, delete, and permission checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EmployeeLanguageDao instance and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeLanguage entity and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of EmployeeLanguage by employeeId, languageId, fluencyId, including null cases.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Verifies search filtering by employee number returns expected languages.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Checks correct counting of EmployeeLanguages based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguagesWithLanguageIds
methods.description: Tests filtering EmployeeLanguages with specific language IDs.

methods.description: Verifies deletion of EmployeeLanguage entries based on criteria.
